style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh yoga-fitness ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, apple-green panel #93BA5A, light bean-green card #DCE9BC, charcoal text #3A3A3A and one lemon-yellow accent #F2C230; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key, gentle fill and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with black-plus-green duotone accents; consistent rounded-corner cards and pill labels with thin-line icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal flat infographic elements; rolled mats always presented as neat cylinders with visible spiral ends and the flat mat taut and wrinkle-free; fully composed frames with balanced margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: rolled mats always shown as neat cylinders with visible spiral ends; flat mat taut and wrinkle-free; stable hero angle and scale across benefit shots
